entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.en: Hmmm... This might be a good[n]opportunity to teach you something...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, Joker! Are you ready to take[n]it down?
Let's go.
One sec.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need to be nervous. This is[n]an easy target.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wh-What the hell was that about? The[n]enemy got sucked into Joker's mask!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I-I have no idea! I wasn't expecting that[n]either...

entries.speaker: Armored Soldier
entries.en: Intruders!? Halt!

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hey, Mona! What was that about!?[n]What did Joker do?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He sealed the enemy's appearance and[n]powers into his mask, and made it his[n]new Persona...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is such a feat even possible? Even I've[n]never seen anyone pull that off!
Is this good?
It's nothing important.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Of course it is! Only one heart exists per[n]person, so normally a person can only[n]have one Persona!

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Incredible! That ability will give us[n]a huge advantage in battle!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, try to do that even more if the[n]opportunity arises! You better help out[n]too, Skull!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah! We'll hold every last one of[n]'em up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hehe, I like you even more now! I really[n]do have something special after all!
